name: DriveBench
description: DriveBench is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the reliability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous driving across 17 settings, including clean, corrupted, and text-only inputs. It includes 19,200 frames, 20,498 question-answer pairs, three question types, and four mainstream driving tasks, assessing VLMs' visual grounding and multi-modal reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A recent benchmark for VLM reliability in autonomous driving; it is emerging rather than broadly established in the community.
notes: Focuses on VLM reliability under various input corruptions and proposes refined evaluation metrics prioritizing robust visual grounding.
